title: GoldCTF 2024
description:
Online open-to-all Attack-Defence for gold diggers willing to spend their lifes ingloriously hitting stones with pickaxe 79 PROTONS COMBINED EDITION CTF

Everything will be cloud-hosted using Wireguard to access the game network.

Registration is available here: https://register.cbsctf.live/ .
All information about game will be posted in telegram channel https://t.me/cbsctf_c .

The main competition chat is https://t.me/cbsctf. It's mostly Russian-speaking, but feel free to use any language or DM admins in case of any issues. There's also an English-speaking chat here: https://t.me/cbsctf_en.
prizes: Pain and Glory for all participants
